habitat: High mountain coniferous/rhododendron forest; alpine meadows; and open forests
story: In the diverse world of birds, the White Tailed Sea Eagle (Turdus albocinctus) stands out. This species, part of the Turdidae family, is a resident of High mountain coniferous/rhododendron forest; alpine meadows; and open forests. Its IUCN Red List status is Least Concern (LC), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The White Tailed Sea Eagle is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the White Tailed Sea Eagle and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
